title: Protein language model-generated enzyme sequences exhibit high stability in molecular dynamics simulations.
authors: Fassi, Enrico Mario Alessandro; Nicolini, Marco; Saitto, Emanuele; Valentini, Giorgio; Casiraghi, Elena; Grazioso, Giovanni
one_liner_zh: 该文结合蛋白语言模型Finenzyme生成酶序列，并通过分子动力学模拟评估其结构稳定性，属于蛋白质序列设计与结构计算验证的交叉研究，方法上融合AI生成与物理模拟，与本课题高度相关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed protein engineering by capturing complex sequence patterns from large datasets, enabling applications such as structure prediction and functional annotation. Finenzyme applies conditional transfer learning to generate biologically plausible enzyme sequences conditioned on Enzyme Commission (EC) numbers. METHODS: In this work, we extended Finenzyme with an in silico selection pipeline that first identifies generated sequences most likely to preserve or enhance the functional characteristics of specific EC categories and then evaluates them through molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to assess their structural stability and conformational dynamics. RESULTS: MD simulations of 236 Finenzyme-generated enzymes across four EC classes (59 micros total simulation time) confirmed high structural stability. Across all enzyme classes, 74-95% of the models maintained stable tertiary structures and correct folding throughout the trajectories, with 195 out of 236 structures (82.6%) exhibiting sustained stability. DISCUSSION: By combining conditional pre-trained language model fine-tuning with dynamic structural evaluation, our framework advances beyond static sequence-based predictions to address the structural and functional dimensions of enzyme behavior, key aspects for both biomedical and industrial applications.
abstract_zh: 引言：大型语言模型（LLMs）通过从大型数据集中捕捉复杂序列模式，彻底改变了蛋白质工程领域，使其能够应用于结构预测和功能注释等任务。Finenzyme 应用条件迁移学习，基于酶委员会（EC）编号生成生物学上合理的酶序列。方法：在本研究中，我们对 Finenzyme 进行了扩展，加入了一个计算机模拟筛选流程，该流程首先识别最有可能保留或增强特定 EC 类别功能特征的生成序列，然后通过分子动力学（MD）模拟评估其结构稳定性和构象动态。结果：对四个 EC 类别中 236 个 Finenzyme 生成酶的 MD 模拟（总模拟时间为 59 微秒）确认了高结构稳定性。在所有酶类别中，74-95% 的模型在整个轨迹中保持了稳定的三级结构和正确折叠，其中 236 个结构中有 195 个（82.6%）表现出持续稳定性。讨论：通过将条件预训练语言模型微调与动态结构评估相结合，我们的框架超越了基于静态序列的预测，解决了酶行为的结构和功能维度，这些方面对生物医学和工业应用均至关重要。
